sampling_scope: Seeded sample of episodes with current single-episode shortlist recommendations and a duration-valid last-30s baseline. Not a random sample of all 50 episodes; conclusions apply to recommended episodes only.
comparison: Highest-scoring current shortlisted promo for each sampled episode vs its own final approximately 30 seconds, snapped to source boundaries. Candidates can have different durations; preference evaluates the complete deliverable.
blinding: Source, rank, score and hook/cliffhanger claims hidden. Side assignment and pair order randomized separately for each reviewer. Text content can still reveal a baseline ending.
analysis: Descriptive vote totals and episode-majority counts. Ratings from different people on one episode are not independent episode samples. No significance or conversion claim.
